content.text: {"what_it_is": {"claims": [{"text": "Test and Evaluation Support (program element 0605807F) is a U.S. Air Force program funded in the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Air Force account.", "citation": {"fact_id": "0469b4f9004c3db4"}}, {"text": "The program provides resources to operate the Air Force Test Center (AFTC) test activities, which are part of the Department of Defense Major Range and Test Facility Base (MRTFB).", "citation": {"fact_id": "e06dc9957e8dfda5"}}, {"text": "Its test facilities and capabilities include wind tunnels, rocket and jet engine test cells, hypersonic and subsonic testing, modeling and simulation, armament test ranges, hardware-in-the-loop and climatic test facilities, avionics test facilities, aircraft testbeds, dry-lakebed landing sites, instrumented test ranges, and the USAF Test Pilot School.", "citation": {"fact_id": "e06dc9957e8dfda5"}}, {"text": "The funding covers institutional test-infrastructure activities such as command and supervisory staffs, maintenance and replacement of worn or obsolete test equipment and facilities, data collection and analysis infrastructure, civilian salaries, range operations, and minor modernization projects, along with depot-level maintenance of institutional test aircraft.", "citation": {"fact_id": "e06dc9957e8dfda5"}}, {"text": "The Air Force Test Center's three Test Wings are supported by the program: Arnold Engineering and Development Complex (AEDC) at Arnold Air Force Base, Tennessee; the 412th Test Wing at Edwards Air Force Base, California; and the 96th Test Wing at Eglin Air Force Base, Florida.", "citation": {"fact_id": "df4e92e5c0237c59"}}, {"text": "The program also funds infrastructure for the 704th Test Group's specialized facilities, including the Central Inertial and GPS Test Facility, the Holloman High Speed Test Track, and the National Radar Cross Section Test Facility.", "citation": {"fact_id": "976ca981250d1540"}}]}, "why_it_matters": {"claims": [{"text": "The program's total funding grows from $936,913 thousand in FY2025 to $1,098,871 thousand (about $1.10 billion) requested for FY2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "16bd52d3e65dd603"}}, {"text": "That is a year-over-year increase of $161,958 thousand (roughly $162 million) from FY2025 to FY2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "d14b472f042e57b8"}}, {"text": "In FY2024 the program recorded actual spending of $960,429 thousand (about $960 million), so the FY2026 request sits modestly above its recent execution level.", "citation": {"fact_id": "6532852821d4b2af"}}, {"text": "The entire FY2026 request of $1,098,871 thousand is discretionary funding; there is no reconciliation (mandatory) component in this program element.", "citation": {"fact_id": "1c4f2b173d5afaaf"}}, {"text": "Because it funds shared institutional infrastructure rather than a single weapon system, the money supports testing not only of Air Force programs but also of other government agencies, foreign military sales, and commercial weapon systems.", "citation": {"fact_id": "8e30313e6a548e56"}}]}, "players": {"claims": [{"text": "The program is run by the U.S. Air Force, with funding drawn from the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Air Force appropriation.", "citation": {"fact_id": "8020b2bd9d3378bf"}}, {"text": "The operating organization is the Air Force Test Center (AFTC), whose three Test Wings — AEDC at Arnold AFB, the 412th Test Wing at Edwards AFB, and the 96th Test Wing at Eglin AFB — are supported by the program.", "citation": {"fact_id": "df4e92e5c0237c59"}}, {"text": "The 704th Test Group operates specialized facilities funded through this program, including the Central Inertial and GPS Test Facility (746th Test Squadron), the Holloman High Speed Test Track (846th Test Squadron), and the National Radar Cross Section Test Facility, and its OL-AA provides test support for the Air Force Research Laboratory Directed Energy Division.", "citation": {"fact_id": "976ca981250d1540"}}]}, "recent_developments": {"claims": []}}
